title: Market Minute 8-11-26- Anthropic Races to IPO; Nvidia Pushes $500 BLN AI Plan
title_zh: 市场纪要 8-11-26-人类竞相 IPO； Nvidia 推出 500 十亿美元人工智能计划
summary: Stocks are subdued in early trading, while crude oil is bouncing between positive and negative territory. Gold and silver are mixed, while the dollar and Treasuries are flatlining.
summary_zh: 股市早盘低迷，而原油则在正值和负值区域之间反弹。黄金和白银涨跌互现，而美元和国债则持平。

title: U.S. IPO Market Has More Room to Rally in H2 2026: ETFs Poised to Win
title_zh: 2026 年下半年美国 IPO 市场有更大上涨空间：ETF 有望获胜
summary: The next phase of the IPO rally could extend beyond tech mega-deals, driven by a more diversified pipeline, benefiting ETFs like FPX and IPO.
summary_zh: 在更加多元化的管道推动下，IPO 反弹的下一阶段可能会超越科技大型交易，从而使 FPX 和 IPO 等 ETF 受益。

title: SK Hynix Eyes Massive U.S. Listing: ETFs That Are Likely to Gain
title_zh: SK 海力士着眼于美国大规模上市：ETF 有望获利
summary: SK Hynix's blockbuster U.S. listing could reshape semiconductor investing. Here's how chip, Korea, Nasdaq and IPO ETFs stand to benefit.
summary_zh: SK 海力士在美国的重磅上市可能会重塑半导体投资。以下是芯片、韩国、纳斯达克和 IPO ETF 的受益方式。

title: IPOs- How Much is TOO Much
title_zh: 首次公开募股——多少才算太多
summary: When I was a kid, I begged my parents to go to Golden Corral. It’s a Southern staple. Not because it has good food, but because it has ALL the food.
summary_zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我恳求我的父母去金畜栏。这是南方的主食。不是因为它有美味的食物，而是因为它拥有所有的食物。

title: Market Minute 6-09-26- OpenAI Joins Heated IPO Race
title_zh: 市场纪要 6-09-26 - OpenAI 加入激烈的 IPO 竞赛
summary: After a mixed day on Wall Street Monday, stocks are looking to advance today. Crude oil is pulling back, while gold, silver, and Treasuries are mostly flat. The dollar is lower.
summary_zh: 周一华尔街涨跌互现，今天股市有望上涨。原油价格正在回落，而黄金、白银和国债大多持平。美元走低。
